diagnostics.summary: argument `sender` for `publish` uses `take` but the parameter is `read`.
diagnostics.label: data effect mismatch
causes: A bare argument is `read`; `mut` and `take` must be written explicitly and match the parameter.

fixes.title: Remove `take` from `sender`: a `read` parameter takes the bare value.
